paragraphs.text: Marath , Will of the Wild is a legendary elemental beast from a shaman-ruled plane .

Marath is an elusive, powerful beast who roams the untamed regions of his world. Although many had tried, few have glimpsed this majestic creature. Some believe he was one of the world's progenitors and has been around since before the dawn of time. As he passes, vines twine out of the earth. Green mist rises around his feet and takes on animalistic forms, while new life is created as he passes by.

He's also infused with elemental magic, and many of the elves who share the wilds with him believe he is the source of growth and natural justice. When threatened, Marath is a ferocious opponent, striking with furious blows and predatory power.
